## Deliverable and sections
Identify the document and affected sections or requirement IDs.

## TA feedback
Quote or summarize the TA’s feedback. Include the rubric category
and a link or page reference to the feedback, where available.

## Required changes
Describe the changes needed to address the feedback.
For grouped issues, organize the changes by requirement family
or document section.

## Completion criteria
State what must be true for this issue to be closed.
Include any related rationale, references or traceability updates
required by the feedback.
